claim: Wu, Kim, Garnett, Gardner (NeurIPS 2023/vol 36, arXiv:2305.15572) provide the first rigorous convergence-rate proof for GIBO, which is the analysis fan2024minucb's own Theorem 1 explicitly compares against (cited as ref [34]) -- this paper's thesis is that local BO PROVABLY CONVERGES under standard assumptions, formalizing prior 'folk wisdom'; it contains no stalling, freeze, or paralysis framing anywhere in its text.
stance_target: Whether the local-BO literature cited alongside/behind fan2024minucb supports an optimizer-never-leaves paralysis framing
scope_conditions: Local Bayesian optimization convergence analysis, GP sample-path objectives with known hyperparameters, noiseless and noisy settings
quoted_support: "The 'folk wisdom' in the literature is that the focus on local optimization sidesteps the curse of dimensionality; however, little is known concretely about the expected behavior or convergence of Bayesian local optimization routines... We then present the first rigorous analysis of such a Bayesian local optimization algorithm recently proposed by Müller et al. (2021), and derive convergence rates in both the noiseless and noisy settings." (Abstract)
